decisions.reason: Although it is more distant from the core offer and only lightly highlighted on the website, it is a newly launched multi-model line for the firm's maritime customer base, so management is likely to continue rather than quickly admit failure.
It builds on the established lighting business and was given its own webpage, so the firm has enough strategic and public commitment to keep backing it in 2019.
This product line fits the industrial customer base very well, required meaningful technical commitment, and was visibly marketed, making withdrawal unlikely so soon after launch.
As a close-to-core product with its own page and a relaunch framed around an already popular task light, it is strongly supported by prior commitment and is likely to stay on the market.
